independence: Key-hidden current worksheet assessment before rereading stored keys; same agent previously saw audit and keys. Not a blind independent reviewer or human sign-off.

assessments.reasoning: Password and PIN are both knowledge; length does not add an independent factor.
The provider processes personal data solely on the retailer’s instructions; it does not determine the purpose.
Inventory records what data exists, its location and ownership; retention, sanitization and masking serve other purposes.
The unpatched flaw is a weakness exploitable by the threat; the server/data are assets and resulting harm is impact.
Business-impact and resource summaries support capital-allocation decisions; raw detail or zero-risk promises do not.
Governance supplies direction, oversight and accountability; account administration and firewall rules are operational implementation.
Mandatory technical specifications are standards; guidelines advise, procedures give steps, policy gives direction.
Using the outline’s technical/administrative/physical categories: software firewall, personnel measures, facility barriers respectively. Other taxonomies may classify activities differently.
Restoring damaged systems is corrective, rather than detecting, preventing or directing behavior.
ISO/IEC 27001 specifies certifiable ISMS requirements; CSF/COBIT governance guidance and SP800-30 risk assessment do not supply that certification standard.
